caption:
does silicone scar gel actually work?

Six trials with 375 people put silicone gel on new surgical scars. Those scars came out flatter, softer and less red than with no gel or a placebo. The difference was moderate.

On scars that were already raised, a Cochrane review rated the evidence very uncertain. Dented acne scars weren't part of these studies.

So the evidence points to starting early, on a new wound.

Send this to the friend who just got stitches.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Wang et al., Int Wound J 2020. doi:10.1111/iwj.13337
Jiang et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2021
